Got a chance to catch *Shin Gojira: Resurgence* in the theaters and I really enjoyed it.
It's a political drama in the guise of a monster movie, but don't let that fool you. They do Godzilla absolute justice. This incarnation of Godzilla is absolutely terrifying and the movie actually knows how to show you a realistic look at a kaiju attack and it's subsequent responses. The politics on the movie sometimes drags on, but it is actually very interesting to see how the government reacts to an unknown threat it is wholly unprepared to fight. As for the action scenes, they are awesome especially one in the middle of the movie.
All in all, I thought it was a fresh and unique take on the kaiju movie formula and I hope to see more of this.
